segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily T-zone skin mostly report the cream absorbs well and dries matte without adding shine, though a few still need to blot midday or use only a thin layer in that zone.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky or very dry skin, including several in cold, low-humidity climates, most often report lasting hydration and fewer dry patches, though one reviewer found it left a dry residue film and broke her out when used on the body.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally like the hydration but a couple note it feels a bit heavy on the T-zone during the day and prefer using it at night.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers who describe sensitive, reactive or atopic skin, some also naming rosacea or eczema, report no burning, stinging or breakouts, but one reviewer with dehydrated, oily, sensitive skin broke out and traced it to specific ingredients in the formula.
segments.normal: The reviewers who describe normal skin report good, non-greasy hydration with no issues.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature, a 48-year-old and a 51-year-old, report light, non-greasy hydration that suits their skin's extra needs.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report smoother, less papery-looking skin and reduced visible dryness around fine lines and crow's feet after consistent use, though none describe it removing lines outright.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently reported benefit: many reviewers, including those with chronically or severely dry skin, describe hydration lasting many hours to a full day or more; two critical reviewers disagree, saying it gave no real hydration and left a dry film or residue.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the cream calmed existing redness, including redness from eczema, over-exfoliation or a damaged barrier, within days to about a month of use.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers credit the cream with repairing a compromised skin barrier, stopping stinging from other actives, ending closed comedones caused by a previous moisturizer, or resolving dry patches, usually within two weeks to two months.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including several with acne-prone or sensitive skin who say other moisturizers usually make them break out; against this, two critical reviewers report their skin went from clear to breakout-prone within days, and one traced her breakouts to specific occlusive ingredients in the formula.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with an oily T-zone mostly report the cream sinks in and dries matte without a greasy look, though several still blot after several hours and one recommends using only a small amount if skin is very oily.
